newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to decide on Thomson sale this month - Juppe.
newsitem.headline: France to decide on Thomson sale this month - Juppe.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe said on Monday that the government would decide this month on the way in which it will privatise defence electronics group Thomson-CSF.

"I think that in the days to come, between now and the end of Februrary, we will be in a position to announce very clearly the procedure, which I want to be as clear and as transparent as possible," he said in a interview on French radio.
"All candidacies will obviously be examined in the context of the procedures we decide on," he added.
France had to call off the privatisation of Thomson-CSF parent Thomson SA last year after the privatisation commission objected to a plan to sell its Thomson Multimedia unit to Daewoo Electronics.
